result.source: Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra (R. Santhanam tr., vol. 2, 1984; G.C. Sharma tr.), ch. 46 v. 185-187 "Drig (Dirga) Dasa" (worked example sequence and Sthira years in Santhanam); Antardashas: BPHS ch. 51 v. 5-12.
conventionNotes: Variant chosen: BPHS ch. 46 v. 185-187 with the Sthira years of the Santhanam worked example. Alternative not used: VAIA ch. 21 orders the aspected signs by the odd-/even-footedness of the 9th/10th/11th and uses Narayana-dasa years.
First dasa runs in full from birth (no balance is defined).
Dasa years: 7 for movable, 8 for fixed, 9 for dual signs (Sthira Dasa spans, BPHS ch. 46 v. 168); one 96-year cycle is generated.

Antardashas (and Pratyantardashas) are 12 equal parts per BPHS ch. 51 v. 5-12: they start from the dasa sign or the 7th from it, whichever is stronger (engine Rasi Bala rules JSD-007); they run onwards for an odd dasa sign and in reverse for an even one; movable signs move to consecutive signs, fixed signs to every 6th sign, dual signs through the kendras of the sign, then of its 5th, then of its 9th.

Stronger-sign choices use the engine's Jaimini Rasi Bala comparison (JSD-007: occupants, association of Jupiter/Mercury/lord, exalted occupants, natural strength, lord in sign of different oddity, lord advancement); a full tie keeps the first-named sign.
result.directionReason: Aspected signs are taken per group: Taurus (onwards), Gemini (onwards), Cancer (backwards) (movable backwards, fixed onwards, dual odd onwards / even backwards).
